memory_candidates.content: In this repo's evidence-probe collection (specs/evidence/), probes never import other probes -- each imports only FormalSystem (checked by grepping every existing WIRED entry's imports). When a new probe needs a result proved in a sibling probe file (e.g. a keystone Equiv living outside the Lake build graph), find an equivalent FormalSystem-only route (e.g. the bare semantic clause plus a landed structural lemma like 'histories = step paths') rather than trying to import the sibling file, which Lean/Lake cannot resolve for a file outside any configured source root.

For ad hoc Lean probes needing a small finite bi-serial frame fixture (FrameOver.ofSlicedStep), using the COMPLETE/total relation (fun _ _ _ => True) on a 2-element carrier (Bool) is a cheap way to get genuine branching (useful for existential-vs-universal-summary divergence tests) while making bi-seriality and the step-path IsStepPath obligation trivial (the Rf-step conjunct becomes `trivial`, leaving only arithmetic on the slice/offset component to prove).
